 Medium

 Print NEW DELHI: Cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal joined the Bharatiya Janata Party on Saturday and was appointed a special invitee to the national executive of party's OBC morcha. The appointment was made by BJP national president Nitin Nabin as part of a new round of appointments to the morcha. "Heartfelt congratulations and best wishes to all newly appointed national office bearers and executive committee members of the BJP OBC (Other Backward Classes) Morcha, as per the directives of the BJP’s esteemed National President, Shri Nitin Nabin ji," BJP's OBC morcha chief said Amarpal Maurya in a post on X, sharing a list of the names who had been appointed to the committee.  Reacting to this, Chahal said, "I sincerely thank respected Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji, respected Home Minister Shri Amit Shah ji, BJP National President Shri Nitin Naveen ji, and OBC Morcha National President Shri Amarpal Maurya ji for giving me a place and respect within the BJP family". The BJP has appointed seven national vice presidents to its OBC Morcha: Jogen Mohan (Assam), Mamata Mohanta (Odisha), Sangam Lal Gupta and Sangeeta Balwant Bind (Uttar Pradesh), Babanrao Ravji Choudhary (Maharashtra), Sat Prakash Rana (Delhi) and Arjun Sahani (Bihar). Gajendra Yadav (Delhi), Pramod Madhwaraj (Karnataka) and Lalit Chandrakar (Chhattisgarh) have been appointed national general secretaries of the morcha.
